newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Sweden's Nov. trade surplus 11.2 bln Skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Sweden's Nov. trade surplus 11.2 bln Skr.

text.p: Sweden's trade balance is expected to show a surplus of 11.2 billion crowns in November, according to a Reuters poll of 13 analysts on Friday.
Forecasts ranged between 8.0 billion crowns and 13.0.

In October, the trade surplus amounted to 12.0 billion crowns and in November 1995, the surplus was 10.6 billion crowns. For the first 10 months of 1996, the surplus was 102 billion crowns, according to Bruno Samuelsson at the national statistics agency SCB.
SCB is due to release November trade balance figures on January 10 at 0900 GMT.

The poll involved analysts from Aragon, Consensus, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, HSBC Midland bank, JP Morgan, Lehman Brothers, Nordbanken, PaineWebber, Salomon brothers, Swedbank, Union Bank of Switzerland and Unibank Markets.
